mentions.note: Called 'flawless' as it continues higher with the retail cohort.
17% revenue growth; 17% DTC SSS (vs 8.5% expected); 25-cent earnings beat; brand on fire; CEO Patrice Louvet's execution stellar on women's apparel and accessories expansion; near all-time highs.

Luxury repositioning insulating from consumer weakness; DTC expansion and international growth (especially Asia at +21.5%) driving 280% 4-year rally with earnings doubled in 3 years. Weakness macro not micro; stock deserves current 21x 2027 PE given momentum and margin expansion.

Exemplary retail execution: elevates brand through aspirational positioning (polo, premium events), drives core with foundational products and women's initiatives, wins key cities globally. Q1 beat EPS/revenue; same-store sales North America +9%, Asia +22%, China +40% all full price; inventory down 3%; operating margin up 170 bps. CEO Louvet demonstrates playbook for pricing power, brand strength, and consistent execution in challenged retail environment.
Up 60% YTD under CEO Patrice Lou; retired 34.1% of shares since 2015; will benefit from Winter Olympics Team USA outfit opportunity; still a buy.
